messages:
amanda.chen: Heads up — Sales flagged a hard ask from AcmeHealth: tamper-evident logging for customer-managed keys + 7y retention for audit logs. They want SLA on log availability for exports.
jonathan.kim: yikes. 7y is a huge storage/ingest cost. Do we treat this as an enterprise add-on or try to bake into a default retention tier?
sanjay: For SOC2 we already keep evidence for 1y by default. 7y pushes us into archival + KMS key-scheduling concerns (rotation, enveloping).
lina-g: From product: customers expect per-tenant export APIs and immutable timelines. Sales says AcmeHealth will sign if we deliver an export workflow + legal-hold flags.
amanda.chen: proposing two options: (A) Enterprise-only archival: per-tenant archives to cold storage, legal-hold toggle, export endpoint, charged separately. (B) Upgrade default retention to 3y everywhere and offer 7y as add-on. Thoughts?
matt_ops: Operationally (A) is cleaner — we isolate cost and access. Need HSM KMS onboarding checklist for customer keys and proof-of-logging flows. Impact: +1 FTE for oncall for first 3 months.
jonathan.kim: can we sketch launch criteria? minimum viable acceptance: 1) immutable append-only export, 2) legal-hold flag that prevents deletion, 3) audit trail for key usage with HSM events. If we can meet those, Sales can close.
sanjay: technical constraints: HSM-backed timestamps for non-repudiation require integration with vendor; otherwise we can produce signed manifests from our KMS daily as a compromise. Also need retention enforcement in export job to respect legal holds.
lina-g: biz constraints: pricing needs to be explicit. Sales wants a matrix: SLA tiers (Hot/Cold/Archive), retention windows, export latency, and per-GB + per-export fees.
amanda.chen: Action items: Jon - draft SLA matrix; Sanjay - feasibility doc for HSM-signed manifests vs vendor timestamping; Matt - ops runbook + oncall cost estimate; Lina - pricing sketch and sales one-pager. Can we aim for canary with AcmeHealth in 6 weeks?
jonathan.kim: I'll post a first-pass SLA matrix by EOD tomorrow. Quick mock in-channel:
```
SLA Tier | Retention | Export SLA | Price
Hot      | 90d      | <1h       | $X/GB
Cold     | 1y       | <24h      | $Y/GB
Archive  | 7y       | 3-5d      | $Z/GB + per-export fee
```
sanjay: If we do Archive, need lifecycle policy + checksum manifests. Also recommend phase gating: canary w/ signed manifests (non-HSM) first, then HSM onboarding as second milestone.
matt_ops: ops note: for canary we'll need a dedicated export queue & throttling + alerting on export failures. I'll add SLOs to the runbook.
amanda.chen: Risk callout: legal-hold semantics vary by region; need counsel review before enabling auto-legal-hold. Also encryption in transit for exported packages must meet AcmeHealth SOC2 scope.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: feature/archival-export -> staging at 2024-07-15 14:00 UTC
lina-g: Nice — once Jon posts matrix I'll align pricing and send to Sales enablement. If we can get Sanjay's feasibility green, I'll set a customer-facing timeline.
amanda.chen: Agreed. We'll review next sync on Friday. If anyone can't meet their action, ping here. :thumbsup:
